title: Nine Months and One Unsigned Page
subtitle: 选择与决定 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 选择与决定（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：选择与决定（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：decision　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 decision 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the headmaster ① made a decision that no governor in the county would have signed, and he said the making was the whole of the office. The ② decision, meaning the choice and not the paper, ran nine months and stayed unsigned on the desk; a decision, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unmade.

Every ③ decision in that school had the same unsigned page against it, and the ④ decision at the end, meaning the one they kept for the last term and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever reversed twice. A decision, the secretary said, is nine parts courage and one part somebody willing to sign; the headmaster said the courage is the part that fills nine months.

The inspector meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the decision was the whole of the report, meaning the ruling and not the choice. The ⑥ decision, meaning the ruling and not any of that, is the only thing in a report that everybody cites and nobody questions; decision, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a choice and a ruling. He said the ruling is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ decision had become a line in a minute, and the minute had become an argument about the unsigned page. The ⑧ decision of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in June, was one school and nine months of signing; decision, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to sign. She said the signing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ decision I remember is the one at the end, which was reversed in 1982 and is still described as the strangest in the county. A ⑩ decision, the secretary said in 1984, is the only thing that improves by being questioned; every decision, she said, is a ruling that has agreed to look like a choice. She said the ruling was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 决定；抉择（指学校里作出的那一个）
B. n. 决定（指那个选择本身，与那张文件相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a decision 作出一个决定
D. n. 决定（指留给最后一学期用的那一个）
E. n. 决定；决断（抽象总称，指一所学校的全部决断）
F. n. 决议（指会议记录里写到、被存档的那一项）
G. n. 裁定；判定（指报告里被引述的那一项）
H. n. 判定（抽象总称，指人人援引却无人质疑的那一项）

items.q: made a decision that no governor in the county would have signed
The decision, meaning the choice and not the paper
the decision was the whole of the report
the decision had become a line in a minute
The decision of the whole thing
A decision, the secretary said in 1984

answers.why: make a decision 意为“作出一个决定”，1963 年校长作出了一个全县没有一位校董肯签字的决定。
decision 意为“决定”，指那个选择本身而不是那张文件，它在桌上搁了九个月而没有签字。
decision 意为“决定”，指那所学校里每一个决定，每一个都对着同一页未签的文件。
decision 意为“决定”，指留给最后一学期用的那一个，是唯一有人推翻过两次的。
decision 意为“裁定、判定”，指报告里被引述的那一项，视察员说这项判定就是那份报告的全部。
decision 意为“判定”，指人人援引却无人质疑的那一项而不是那个选择，是报告里人人都援引、却无人质疑的东西。
decision 意为“决议”，指会议记录里写到、被存档的那一项，到 1970 年这项决定成了记录里的一行。
decision 意为“决定、决断”，校长六月写道，整件事的决断是一所学校和九个月的签署。
decision 意为“决定”，我记得的是末尾那一个，1982 年被推翻，至今仍被说成全县最奇的一个。
decision 为抽象总称，秘书 1984 年说，一个决定是唯一会因为被质疑而变得更好的东西。
